site.site_name: Land off Poplar Farm Lane, Meppershall
site.address: Land adjacent to Poplar Farm Lane, Meppershall, Central Bedfordshire

results_summary.source: Central Bedfordshire Local Plan Policy Map
results_summary.screening_interpretation: Site lies within the defined settlement envelope.
No Green Belt designation intersects the site or buffers.

Flood Zone 2 present 190 m from site boundary, associated with an unnamed ordinary watercourse; does not intersect the site itself. FRA not automatically triggered by Flood Zone but drainage strategy required regardless.

results_summary.feature_name: Church of St Thomas a Becket (Grade II*)
results_summary.screening_interpretation: Listed building 210 m from site; intervening built form likely limits intervisibility but a heritage setting screening note is recommended.
No SSSI/SAC/SPA/LNR intersects site or buffers. Priority Habitat (traditional orchard) recorded 80 m north.
Former yard use indicates potential made ground and low-level contamination risk; Phase 1 desk study recommended.
Site has frontage to an unclassified road. Adoption status not confirmed with the Highway Authority.
